Coverage matrix

Each cell shows what this repository has recorded for one jurisdiction and one policy area. Statuses describe research activity, not compliance or legal effect.

An empty or not-started cell means the research has not been done here. It does not mean that no law or policy exists.

How to read the statuses

  • Not started: No task, candidate source or policy record is recorded for this combination.
  • Source discovery: A discovery task is recorded, but no candidate source is listed yet.
  • Candidate sources identified: At least one candidate source lead is listed. It has not been captured, verified or interpreted.
  • Source captured: A policy record exists, but no provision has been extracted yet.
  • Provision extraction: Provisions are recorded, but interpretation questions are not yet recorded.
  • Legal review pending: Provisions and open interpretation questions are recorded; qualified legal review is still pending.
  • Reviewed findings: Every policy record in the cell has a confirmed legal-effect finding, a recorded review entry and no open interpretation question.
  • Blocked: A recorded task is blocked. A blocked task is not a legal finding.
